pages.title: Цель симуляции
pages.text: Now that you've found $(item)The Midnight$() pocket dimension, we want you to exploit the magic emanating from all the natural flora that can be found there.$(br2)The portal piece you need to craft to reach the next $(item)Simulation$() will require a $(item)Highly Irradiated Magic Core$() as the primary power source to power the portal.
